card.name: Small words in astronomy descriptions
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as the, a, smaller or usually, in astronomy passages about galaxies, comets and stars. They come right before a noun describing a celestial object or feature.

modes.label: Articles before galaxy terms
modes.description: The words the or a sit just before a galaxy or companion noun in a description of galaxy collisions or star formation.
modes.example: is driven by<< the>> gravitational interaction with its neighbor, M8

modes.label: Articles in comet description
modes.description: The word a or an opening quote comes before coma or tail in a description of a comet.
modes.example: creating a distinctive glow called<< a>> "coma," and a long, bright

modes.label: Modifiers before astronomy nouns
modes.description: Adjectives or adverbs such as smaller or usually come before a galaxy or detector noun.
modes.example: The host galaxies of Seyferts are<< usually>> spiral or irregular galaxies.

card.writes: It seems to suppress acceleration words and boost color or star words, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in science writing about galaxies, stars and comets.
